items.title: Codex policy boundary remains locally gated as Guardian and browser/computer policy evolve
items.summary: Codex continued changing Guardian, MCP/tool and browser/computer-use policy surfaces while the subject policy contract remained unchanged and no executable local compatibility witness was available.
items.localContractImpact: Keep the blocking gate open before adopting current Codex policy semantics into spec/.codex or controller assumptions.

observations.observation: The 81-commit delta includes browser/computer-use requirements, Guardian session/policy changes and continued MCP-facing behavior; ctrl@main did not change and executable compatibility was not run.

claims.text: Current Codex policy behavior cannot be treated as locally compatible until the declared local gate is executed.

items.title: Codex protocol, generated schema and rollout metadata changed together
items.summary: Codex added browser/computer configuration requirements and a guardian_review thread source projected through app-server/generated schemas and rollout metadata.
items.localContractImpact: Reconcile local app-server/config/rollout projections before treating current main as protocol-compatible.

observations.observation: Current main exposes Browser/Computer Use requirements through app-server/generated schemas and propagates guardian_review source metadata through protocol and rollouts.

claims.text: The declared Codex protocol/schema/runtime projection differs from the previous admitted baseline.

items.summary: The v3 profile newly requires Weaver as the projected DiagnosticPacket interface realization; the channel resolves at 78b64d8da8e0034374e66a560ae22991b2e88a81 without a historical delta.
items.localContractImpact: Treat Weaver as interface validation/projection evidence only until a repo-backed DiagnosticPacket consumer and executable CUE criterion exist.

observations.observation: Current Weaver main resolves and provides registry resolve/check/generate machinery; no previous admitted ctrl channel exists for historical comparison.

claims.text: Weaver can realize a semantic interface but cannot qualify an EvaluationWorld or manufacture ctrl semantic authority.
